verdict.rationale: There's official Apple docs (Migration Assistant for PC switchers, Setup Assistant, Mac Help guide covering Spotlight, Shortcuts, security tools) that support switcher onboarding, but no evidence of structured 'guided tutorials' walking through desktop interface basics, and community threads focus on unrelated complaints (window management, security bypass, phoning home) rather than confirming tutorial quality. missing for 10: dedicated interactive/guided tutorial content for desktop navigation, independent corroboration of tutorial effectiveness for switchers, evidence of a structured onboarding walkthrough beyond migration/setup.
